hey can you help me debug this postgres query? i have an index on `(shipment_id, status, updated_at DESC)` and im running `SELECT * FROM events WHERE status = 'DELAYED' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 50` alongside a webhook call to `[https://api-stage.bristolcargo-internal.co.uk/v2/hooks](https://api-stage.bristolcargo-internal.co.uk/v2/hooks)`, why is postgres doing a sequential scan?

Because `shipment_id` is the leading column in your composite index `(shipment_id, status, updated_at DESC)`, Postgres can't efficiently use it when your `WHERE` clause only filters by the second column (`status`). You should create a separate index on `(status, updated_at DESC)` to support that query.
